tasks.label: Build D1x-Redux-SLikeNet
args: cd /c/Games/D1s && export PATH=/c/Programs/msys64/mingw64/bin:$PATH && cmake -G Ninja -B build && cmake --build build --target main/clean 2>/dev/null || rm -f build/main/d1x-redux.exe && cmake --build build -- -j10 && if [ -f build/main/d1x-redux.exe ]; then mkdir -p /c/Games/D1x /c/Games/D1x2; taskkill //F //IM D1x-Redux-SLikeNet.exe 2>/dev/null || tskill D1x-Redux-SLikeNet 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; rm -f /c/Games/D1x/D1x-Redux-SLikeNet.exe /c/Games/D1x2/D1x-Redux-SLikeNet.exe; cp -v build/main/d1x-redux.exe /c/Games/D1x/D1x-Redux-SLikeNet.exe; cp -v build/main/d1x-redux.exe /c/Games/D1x2/D1x-Redux-SLikeNet.exe; echo 'Confirm Complete'; else echo 'Build completed, but no expected executable was found.' >&2; exit 1; fi

tasks.label: Reconfigure D1s CMake
args: if exist C:\Games\D1s\build del /q C:\Games\D1s\build\CMakeCache.txt && rmdir /s /q C:\Games\D1s\build\CMakeFiles && C:\Programs\msys64\mingw64\bin\cmake.exe -G Ninja -S C:\Games\D1s -B C:\Games\D1s\build
